name: libredb-studio
description: Read schemas and run bounded, read-only statements through your LibreDB Studio, which keeps the credentials and runs no model for MCP.

mcp_url.title: Studio MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Your Studio's LIBREDB_MCP_URL, ending in /api/mcp: https, unless Studio runs on this computer

mcp_token.title: MCP token
mcp_token.description: A token minted on your Studio's /settings/mcp screen
